assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column — this was missing in the @ParameterizedTest and should be added.
At least one output column name ends with '?' (e.g. 'Valid?' or 'Expected?')
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
Scenario names describe conditions ('Valid standard format', 'Missing local part') — not outcomes ('True', 'False') or 'Test case 1'.
assertions.evidence: Scenario names include: 'Simple address', 'Country-code TLD', 'Plus addressing with dot', 'No @ symbol', 'Missing local part', 'Missing domain label before TLD', 'Missing TLD', 'Empty string'

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case.
assertions.evidence: 1 @TableTest method name(s) read as descriptive titles (no @DisplayName needed)

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
The build file (build.gradle) includes org.tabletest:tabletest-junit:1.2.1 as a test dependency
The generated test code compiles successfully against the project scaffolding
The generated tests pass when executed against EmailValidator
